name: jumphp/collision
description: Collisions for JumPHP games: circles, boxes and convex polygons, overlap tests with the way out, rays, a broad phase (spatial hash)

jumphp.name: Collision
jumphp.summary: Shapes (circle, box, convex polygon), the separating axis test with the minimum translation, rays and a spatial hash broad phase.
features: Collision::test() gives the normal and the depth: how to push apart

SpatialHash broad phase and a CollisionWorld service: collisions(), at(), overlapping(), raycast()
Pure PHP on floats: the same in the browser
